verdict.rationale: Live probes confirm a working llms.txt at docs.morphllm.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200, structured index with base URL and API notes). Docs pages are also served as raw markdown (.md) and explicitly point agents to the llms.txt index, which is exactly what an agent needs to consume the docs. Missing for 10: no evidence of a fuller agent bundle (e.g. llms-full.txt) or a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probes 404), and no independent user corroboration of agents consuming these docs.
